name: Lentegí (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a wavy diagonal band of green, white and green from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: The municipality of Lentegí has had its own arms and flag since 2006, when they were approved by the council in plenary; since they were never entered in the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales they lack official status, although this does not prevent their widespread use.
